assumptions: Traffic is a synthetic 40 request/s workload derived from the inspected route mix; it is not observed production traffic.
Service and database times are transparent model parameters. They are not benchmarked from the repository.
The baseline is the detected architecture with one service replica and no cache, retry, queue offload or read replica unless source evidence proves otherwise.
Cache hit rates are fixed assumptions by TTL (10 s: 45%, 30 s: 65%, 90 s: 78%). They are not measured cache statistics.
The model assumes the service and database are the bottlenecks. Network jitter, garbage collection, provider outages and cold starts are not simulated.
Only deployment-level controls are varied. Application code, schemas and business logic are unchanged.
No repository code, dependency, package manager, container or service was executed.
A recommendation is an uncalibrated candidate for real deployment validation. It is not a measured winner.
Applicable controls for this source: cache_ttl_s, offload_jobs, rate_limit, replicas, retry_policy.
